_comment: Cards that exist only for the life-gain addend test (tests/unit/players/test_life_gain_addend.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_vitality` is Angel of Vitality's replacement line on its own, on an artifact so nothing else about it can matter. `t_opponent_vitality` points the same replacement at the opponents, the half no printed card has and the only way to test `affects_player` here. `t_vitality_body` is the Angel's other line on its own -- a 2/2 that gets +2/+2 as long as its controller has 25 or more life -- so the test can pin that a static condition reads its controller's own life total and follows it as it moves. The doubler is `t_archive` from life_gain_replacement.cards.json, the lifelinker `t_lifelink_bear` from life_loss_replacement.cards.json, and the gain spell `t_gain_spell`.
